aiAssist.common.costNotice: Costs are billed to your own Anthropic account. The Claude assist features never resend a request or switch models on their own.
aiAssist.common.dataNotice: The text you enter and any image you choose go straight from this browser to Anthropic. They do not pass through ToonStudio servers.
aiAssist.common.estimateNote: Estimated from the public prices as of {date}. Your Anthropic console is the source of truth for billing.
aiAssist.card.title: Claude (Anthropic)
aiAssist.card.subtitle: Use your own Anthropic API key for sharper dialogue and direction ideas, panel image review, translation, alt text and the AI command helper.
aiAssist.card.keyNotice: The key stays in this tab's memory only. To save it encrypted, use the advanced settings below. A dedicated key with a workspace spend limit is recommended.
aiAssist.card.modelHint: You can change the model any time. The app never swaps models quietly to save cost.
aiAssist.card.consent: I understand requests go to Anthropic with my key and are billed to my account
aiAssist.card.needConsent: Confirm the data transfer and billing terms.
aiAssist.card.makeDefault: Use as the default text AI
aiAssist.card.defaultApplied: Text AI now uses Claude. The routing order switched to manual mode.
aiAssist.card.defaultHint: Existing text AI such as dialogue, translation and palettes will go to Claude too. You can change this any time under AI usage order above.
aiAssist.card.usageUnpriced: {count} calls to models with unknown prices are not included in the cost.
aiAssist.card.featuresTitle: What you can do with Claude
aiAssist.card.featureArt: AI Art Director — reviews reading order, balloons and readability of a panel or page, with locations
aiAssist.card.featurePlan: AI Command Helper — describe a task and get a sequence of studio commands
aiAssist.card.featureText: Existing dialogue, translation, palette and storyboard AI can use Claude too
aiAssist.art.title: AI Art Director
aiAssist.art.description: Upload a panel or page image and get reading order, balloon, contrast and mobile readability feedback with locations.
aiAssist.art.dropTitle: Drop or paste the image to review
aiAssist.art.dropHint: PNG · JPEG · WebP · up to 12MB each
aiAssist.art.previewAlt: Preview of the image to review
aiAssist.art.segmentHint: Tall images are reviewed in sections. Each section is billed separately.
aiAssist.art.moodPlaceholder: e.g. the stillness of a late-night store
aiAssist.art.notesPlaceholder: Tell it what you most want checked
aiAssist.art.running: Reviewing now. This usually takes a few dozen seconds.
aiAssist.art.error: The review did not finish. Check the details and try again. ({message})
aiAssist.art.invalidFile: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are supported. Choose a different file.
aiAssist.art.tooLarge: The image is too large. Choose a file up to 12MB.
aiAssist.art.unreadable: The image could not be read. Choose a different file.
aiAssist.art.issuesNone: No clear problems were found. Still, take one more look yourself.
aiAssist.art.overlayNote: Locations are rough areas estimated by the model.
aiAssist.art.tooManyPixels: The image has too many pixels. Split it into shorter parts or reduce its size, then choose it again.
aiAssist.art.stopped: The review was stopped. The part already processed may still have been billed. Try again when you are ready.
aiAssist.art.notReviewed: This section has not been reviewed yet. Use the button below to run the review.
aiAssist.art.overlayHint: Select an issue to highlight where it is on the image.
aiAssist.plan.title: AI Command Helper
aiAssist.plan.description: Describe what you want to do and get a sequence of studio commands. Nothing runs until you review and press run.
aiAssist.plan.proposalNote: The plan is only a proposal. Nothing changes in the studio until you press run.
aiAssist.plan.requestPlaceholder: e.g. fit the canvas to the window and turn on the grid
aiAssist.plan.stopped: Planning was stopped. The part already processed may still have been billed. Try again when you are ready.
aiAssist.plan.candidates: Sent {count} commands. {usable} can be used right now.
aiAssist.plan.noCandidates: No commands are available to the AI right now. Reopen this from the studio screen.
aiAssist.plan.stepsHint: Uncheck any step you do not want. Selected steps run in order from the top.
aiAssist.plan.stepsNone: No command matches this request. Check the questions below and ask again.
aiAssist.plan.rejected: Left out {count} commands that are not in the list or cannot be used.
aiAssist.plan.noneSelected: Select at least one step to run.
aiAssist.plan.reasonStopped: Stopped, so this did not run.
aiAssist.plan.reasonMissing: This command is not available right now.
aiAssist.plan.reasonDisabled: This command cannot be used right now.
aiAssist.plan.reasonPreviousFailed: An earlier step stopped, so this did not run.
aiAssist.plan.undoHint: Some commands can be undone with Ctrl+Z / ⌘+Z, but view and tool settings may need to be changed back by hand.
aiAssist.plan.error: The plan did not finish. Check the details and try again. ({message})
aiAssist.preflight.title: Check before you run
aiAssist.preflight.routeValue: This browser → Anthropic (your Anthropic API key). ToonStudio servers are not involved.
aiAssist.preflight.costValue: Billed to your Anthropic account. Up to about {cost} (based on the output limit).
aiAssist.preflight.costUnknown: Billed to your Anthropic account. The price of this model is unknown, so it cannot be estimated up front. Check Anthropic's price list before you run it.
aiAssist.preflight.failureValue: Nothing is resent and the model is never swapped automatically. If something goes wrong you see why, and you decide whether to try again.
aiAssist.budget.title: Session budget
aiAssist.budget.hint: With a limit set, every request sent to Claude is compared with the remaining budget before it goes out. If it could exceed the limit it is not sent and you are told why. In the assist dialogs you can go ahead "just this once"; other AI features such as chat need the limit raised or removed. Only this limit number is stored in this browser.
aiAssist.budget.exceeds: Only {remaining} of your {limit} session budget is left. This request can cost up to {cap}, so it may go over budget.
aiAssist.budget.unknown: {remaining} of your {limit} session budget is left. The price of this model is unknown, so the request may not stay within it.
aiAssist.budget.override: Run this once even if it goes over budget
aiAssist.steps.createKey: Create an API key in the Anthropic console
aiAssist.steps.createKeyHint: A key dedicated to this app, in a workspace with a spend limit, is recommended.
aiAssist.steps.paste: Paste the key and pick a model
aiAssist.steps.pasteHint: The key stays in this tab's memory only. After a reload you enter it again.
aiAssist.steps.verify: Connect and verify, and you are done
aiAssist.steps.verifyHint: Checking the key is free. Charges only happen when you actually run an AI assist.
aiAssist.art.contextHint: Genre, mood and notes help the review fit your work.
aiAssist.art.studioCopyTip: Copy the current page with Studio's “Copy image to clipboard”, then paste it here.
aiAssist.art.clipboardUnsupported: This browser cannot paste with the button. Copy the image, then press Ctrl/⌘+V in this window.
aiAssist.art.clipboardDenied: The clipboard could not be read. Allow access, or paste with Ctrl/⌘+V.
aiAssist.art.clipboardEmpty: There is no image on the clipboard. Copy an image and press the button again.
aiAssist.art.needImage: Add an image to review first.
aiAssist.art.needBudget: Tick the budget confirmation to run.
aiAssist.art.preflightTransfer: One image ({width}×{height}px, {size}KB) and the context text you entered
aiAssist.art.preflightTransferNone: No image yet. Its size appears here once you add one.
aiAssist.art.preflightTime: Usually tens of seconds. If it is not done after 3 minutes, it stops and tells you.
aiAssist.art.preflightOutput: One review: scores, reading order and a list of fixes with locations
aiAssist.art.preflightProtection: The image is not saved or changed; it is only analyzed. Results stay in this window.
aiAssist.plan.modeDoNote: Say what you want and get a proposed order of commands. Only the steps you confirm run.
aiAssist.plan.modeExplainNote: Ask about a feature or shortcut. The studio does not change.
aiAssist.plan.questionPlaceholder: e.g. How do I merge layers?
aiAssist.plan.knowledgeCount: Answers are based on {count} studio features.
aiAssist.plan.exampleDo1: Fit the canvas to the window and turn on the grid
aiAssist.plan.exampleDo3: Turn on both the rulers and the grid
aiAssist.plan.exampleAsk2: How do I zoom in and out?
aiAssist.plan.exampleAsk3: How do I save my work?
aiAssist.plan.stale: You changed the request. The plan below is for the previous one.
aiAssist.plan.preflightTransferDo: Your request and the names, descriptions and shortcuts of {count} studio commands, including which ones cannot be used right now
aiAssist.plan.preflightTransferAsk: Your question and the names, descriptions and shortcuts of {count} studio features
aiAssist.plan.preflightTime: Usually a few seconds to ten-odd. If it is not done after 3 minutes, it stops and tells you.
aiAssist.plan.preflightOutputDo: One proposed order of commands (you confirm running separately)
aiAssist.plan.preflightOutputAsk: One explanation and a list of related features
aiAssist.plan.preflightProtectionDo: Making a plan does not change the studio. Running needs you to pick steps and press the button.
aiAssist.plan.preflightProtectionAsk: The studio does not change. Only a command you press “Run now” on runs.
aiAssist.hub.sectionSubtitle: Use image review, translation, alt text and the command helper right away, no key needed. Register your own key and they run on it instead.
aiAssist.hub.connectPrompt: Connect an Anthropic API key to use image analysis, translation, alt text and the command helper. Costs are billed to your own Anthropic account.
aiAssist.hub.artDescription: Reviews reading order, balloons and legibility of a panel or page, with locations.
aiAssist.hub.planDescription: Say what you want for a proposed command order, or ask how and get shortcuts.
aiAssist.preset.quickDesc: Fast and cheap with Haiku 5.5, with a little less detail.
aiAssist.preset.defaultDesc: Balanced, with the model set on your connection ({model}).
aiAssist.preset.preciseDesc: Thinks harder with the connection's model ({model}). Takes longer and costs more.
aiAssist.preset.customDesc: Pick the model and thinking depth yourself.
aiAssist.preset.depthHint: Deeper is more accurate but slower and costs more.
aiAssist.localize.title: AI translation helper
aiAssist.localize.description: Translates your balloon lines one by one, keeping their numbers. It also tells you whether each line fits its balloon and follows your glossary.
aiAssist.localize.linesHint: Put one balloon per line. Blank lines are skipped.
aiAssist.localize.linesPlaceholder:
e.g. Oh, it's raining.
I don't have an umbrella…
aiAssist.localize.lineCount: {count} lines · up to {max} at a time
aiAssist.localize.sampleText:
Oh, it's raining.
I don't have an umbrella…
Want to share mine?
aiAssist.localize.budgetHint: Sets how much longer than the original a translation may be. Lines that go over come with a shorter option.
aiAssist.localize.glossaryInvalid: {count} lines don't match the format and are skipped. Write them as 'source = translation'.
aiAssist.localize.glossaryOverflow: Only the first {max} terms are used. {count} were left out.
aiAssist.localize.notesPlaceholder: e.g. The lead speaks casually. Keep sound effects as they are.
aiAssist.localize.problemTooMany: That's {count} lines. You can translate up to {max} at a time — split them and run again.
aiAssist.localize.problemTooLong: Line {line} is {length} characters. A line can be up to {max} characters — split it.
aiAssist.localize.running: Translating… with many lines this can take a few minutes.
aiAssist.localize.stopped: Translation stopped. The part already processed may still have been billed. Try again if you need to.
aiAssist.localize.done: Translation finished. You can edit each line right away.
aiAssist.localize.error: Translation did not finish. Check the input and try again. ({message})
aiAssist.localize.stale: You changed the lines. The result below is for the previous lines — translate again to refresh it.
aiAssist.localize.preflightTransfer: {count} lines ({chars} characters), {terms} glossary terms, and the context you typed
aiAssist.localize.preflightTransferNone: No lines yet. The line count shows up here once you type.
aiAssist.localize.preflightTime: Usually tens of seconds; many lines can take a few minutes. If it isn't done after 5 minutes, it stops and tells you.
aiAssist.localize.preflightOutput: A translation, a shorter option and a note for each line (by line number)
aiAssist.localize.preflightProtection: Your lines are never saved or changed. The result stays in this window and only reaches your work when you copy and paste it.
aiAssist.localize.summary: {count} translated · {over} too wide · {terms} to check against the glossary · {missing} missing
aiAssist.localize.discarded: {count} items with mismatched numbers were discarded.
aiAssist.localize.missingLine: No translation came back for this line. Type one yourself or translate again.
aiAssist.hub.localizeDescription: Translates balloon lines keeping their numbers, then checks that each fits its balloon and follows your glossary.
aiAssist.altText.title: AI alt-text helper
aiAssist.altText.description: Upload a cut or page and get a one-line alt text, a detailed description and per-panel descriptions for readers who can't see the image.
aiAssist.altText.needImage: Upload an image to describe first.
aiAssist.altText.running: Looking at the image and writing the description. This usually takes 10 to 30 seconds.
aiAssist.altText.stopped: Stopped. The part already processed may still have been billed. Try again if you need to.
aiAssist.altText.done: Description ready. You can edit it right away.
aiAssist.altText.error: Could not create the description. Check the input and try again. ({message})
aiAssist.altText.notGenerated: No description yet. Use the button below to run it.
aiAssist.altText.notGeneratedSegment: This section has no description yet. Use the button below to run it.
aiAssist.altText.previewNote: The preview image uses the one-line text below as its alt text — this is what a screen reader will say for this image.
aiAssist.altText.scopeBriefHint: Only a one-line alt text. Fastest and cheapest.
aiAssist.altText.scopeStandardHint: A one-line alt text plus a detailed description of the scene.
aiAssist.altText.scopeDetailedHint: Also walks through each panel in reading order, including the dialogue and sound-effect text. Takes longer and costs more.
aiAssist.altText.notesPlaceholder: e.g. The blue-haired one is Sora; the one with glasses is Minsu
aiAssist.altText.notesHint: Names you give here are used as written. Names you leave out are never invented.
aiAssist.altText.preflightTransfer: 1 image ({width}×{height}px, {size}KB) and the notes you typed
aiAssist.altText.preflightTransferNone: No image yet. Its size shows up here once you upload one.
aiAssist.altText.preflightTime: Usually 10–30 seconds. If it isn't done after 3 minutes, it stops and tells you.
aiAssist.altText.preflightOutputStandard: A one-line alt text and a detailed description
aiAssist.altText.preflightOutputDetailed: A one-line alt text, a detailed description and per-panel descriptions (with visible text)
aiAssist.altText.preflightProtection: The image is never saved or changed; it is only described. The result stays in this window and only reaches your work when you copy and paste it.
aiAssist.altText.shortHint: Around 125 characters is easy for screen readers to read in one go. You can keep a longer one, but shorter usually lands better.
aiAssist.altText.panelsEmpty: No panel descriptions came back. Try generating again.
aiAssist.hub.altTextDescription: Writes a one-line alt text, a detailed description and panel-by-panel notes for readers who can't see the image.
aiAssist.card.featureLocalize: AI Translation Helper — translates balloon lines keeping their numbers and checks fit and glossary
aiAssist.card.featureAltText: AI Alt-text Helper — writes descriptions for readers who can't see the image
aiAssist.preflight.costPending: Add an image or text and the maximum cost of this request is calculated here. It is billed to your own Anthropic account.
aiAssist.preflight.failureShort: Nothing is resent and the model is never switched automatically.
aiAssist.budget.unconfirmed: {count} request(s) got no response and are not counted in the usage. They may still have been billed (up to {cost}). Check the exact amount in the Anthropic console.
aiAssist.common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself, or check the browser's clipboard permission.
aiAssist.common.trimmedNotice: {count} item(s) were shortened or left out because of length or count limits. A cut-off sentence may end abruptly.
aiAssist.art.coverageTruncated: The image is very tall: only the top {covered}px ({percent}%) of its {total}px height can be split into sections. Crop the rest and upload it again.
aiAssist.localize.sameLanguage: The source and target languages are the same. Change one of them.
aiAssist.localize.glossaryDuplicate: {count} line(s) repeat a source term already listed above, so only the first one is used.
aiAssist.localize.manyLinesHint: That is a lot of lines ({count}). They are sent in {chunks} batches one after another, and the cost cap covers all batches together.
aiAssist.localize.indexShifted: The AI numbered the lines from 0, so they were shifted by one to line up. Please check that each source line and translation are paired correctly.
aiAssist.localize.partialNotice: Only {done} of {total} batches were translated. Lines that were not translated are flagged. Running again translates everything from the start and is billed again.
aiAssist.art.fromCanvasBusy: Rendering the current canvas page as an image.
aiAssist.art.fromCanvasFailed: Could not get the canvas page as an image. Try again in a moment or upload an image yourself.
aiAssist.hub.managedNote: Runs free on ToonStudio AI without a key. Register your own key and it runs on that key instead.
aiAssist.managed.routeValue: This browser → ToonStudio server → high-performance AI (within the daily limit) → free AI, in that order. Your own key is not used.
aiAssist.managed.costValue: Free. Nothing is billed to you. There is a daily usage limit.
aiAssist.managed.failureValue: If one AI is busy or has hit its limit, the request moves to the next AI before any answer is written. If none is available you see why, and you decide whether to try again.
aiAssist.managed.failureShort: If one AI is busy, the next one takes over.
aiAssist.managed.loginHint: Sign in to use this without a key; it then runs on ToonStudio AI right away. With your own key registered, you can use it without signing in.
